spec.join: _earlydelay_arm_cells harvests each calendar's own annual return + turnover, the gap rows, and the E66 early/asymmetry answers; the late-face pointer and the honest lines are not joined because they are references, not measurements
spec.control: the same arm joined against itself; every cell must read delta 0.0 or the join machinery moved the numbers

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.delta_units: each delta is in the units of its column: bp for gaps, percent per year for annualised returns, turns/yr for turnover -- the summary max is a max over mixed units and is a screen, not a quantity

null_cells.note: a cell null on BOTH arms is not one-sided: at start=2020-01-01 the pre2017 era carries no bars, so those cells are empty by construction in both arms

answers.reading: the repair reaches the early ladder: 55 of 93 cells move (25 book, 22 gap, 8 other) and 0 cell(s) exist on one arm only

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
the screened arm repairs prints inside the panel it is handed; it does not add or remove bars, so an unchanged universe_members count is a property of the repair, not evidence the panel is clean

the early decision re-ranks on a date when fewer names have published, so a repair can change the picked set; a stable gap with both books moving is not the same finding as a stable gap with neither moving
the late column of the asymmetry block is read from the E65 face on disk at the same cutoff+start, in both arms identically, so it cannot contribute a delta and is disclosed only for context
E97 counts the published numbers of this runner; the join covers the book/gap/early/asymmetry cells, not the pointer fields
